name: Baricitinib
description: Janus kinase (JAK1 and JAK2) inhibitor taken by mouth, a small-molecule immune drug

note.text: Alopecia areata is an autoimmune disease. Baricitinib is not approved for male pattern hair loss.

bullets: **JAK enzymes** pass on signals from cytokine and growth-factor receptors
**Blocks JAKs,** preventing activation of STATs, which modulate gene expression
**Cytokines** blocked are thought to drive the immune attack on hair follicles
SALT 20 or less at week 36: 35.9–38.8% (4 mg)

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in about 1 hour; mostly kidney clearance; CYP3A4 minor
practical.monitored: Lymphocytes, neutrophils, hemoglobin, liver enzymes, lipids

regulatory.text: Boxed warning: infections, cancer, heart, clots

references: King et al., N Engl J Med, BRAVE-AA1 and BRAVE-AA2, May 2022
